info.name: Daily summaries of transactional refined products volumes for rack loadings at the PADD.

params.name: regions
params.description:
List of PADD regions separated by commas.
Value of 1 groups 1A, 1B, 1C. 1 excludes 1A,1B,1C
Value of USA groups all regions. USA excludes all other regions

params.name: products
params.description: List of general refined products classes (gasoline or distillates) separated by commas

params.name: grades
params.description: List of grades separated by commas

params.name: limit
params.description: Deprecated. Specifies number (1-5000) of records that will be provided. Default 200.

params.name: offset
params.description: Deprecated. Specifies number of records that will be skipped. When not provided, the returned records will start with the first record.

params.name: page
params.description: This is the page being requested. The default is page 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: This is the amount of objects on each page. Default is 200.  Maximum is 5000.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Beginning of date range (e.g. "YYYY-MM-DD").

params.name: endDate
params.description: End of date range (e.g. "YYYY-MM-DD").

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response data. If not provided, the type specified by the Accept header will be used. If neither are provided, the type returned will be JSON.

items.docs: Daily summaries of transactional refined products volumes for rack loadings at the PADD.
